proof_scope: live non-expert analyst retrieval, abstention calibration, and declared knowledge-coverage over the SPARTA corpus

claims.proves: that a non-expert operator can resolve security identifiers across CWE/CAPEC/ATT&CK/D3FEND/NVD from the live corpus, that fabricated identifiers are rejected, and that a randomly generated, verified-absent CVE identifier returns NOT_IN_CORPUS with an explicit confirm-upstream caveat -- decisive-with-caveat under the near-complete local CVE corpus, a fresh random identifier every run; and that every framework declared covered in coverage_manifest.json still resolves; and that the framework alignment invariants hold live: zero unexpected orphan frameworks and zero cross-collection case collisions (check 30, EMB3D declared as expected orphan), zero edge labels contradicting their own endpoints and zero unlabelled edges (check 31), with a sensitivity case proving check 31 still reports the deliberately surfaced dangling-endpoint findings rather than having been vacuously weakened; plus non-deterministic e2e sweeps: a fresh random edge sample is endpoint-congruent and fresh verified-absent identifier mutants never resolve, seeds printed for reproduction
claims.does_not_prove: plausibility judgment -- whether an exploitation chain is realistic, whether a detection rule would false-positive in production, or whether an AI's threat analysis is operationally sound. Those still require a practitioner.

cases.name: random-absent-cve-is-refuted-with-caveat
command:
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  ID="CVE-$((RANDOM % 23 + 2002))-9$((RANDOM % 900 + 9000))9"
  HITS=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8601/recall/by-keys -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"collection\":\"sparta_controls\",\"keys\":[\"$ID\"],\"key_field\":\"control_id\"}" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin).get("documents",[])))')
  if [ "$HITS" = "0" ]; then echo "probing verified-absent $ID"; python3 ../scripts/analyst_probe.py resolve "$ID"; exit $?; fi
done
echo "no absent id found in 5 draws"; exit 1

cases.name: random-sampled-edges-congruent-e2e
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/sparta && uv run python scripts/adversarial_alignment_probe.py edges --samples 20

cases.name: mutated-identifiers-never-resolve-e2e
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/sparta && uv run python scripts/adversarial_alignment_probe.py mutate --samples 8
